summary: Add a non-authoritative, self-deleting, agent-namespaced ephemeral session planner with deterministic DAG eligibility and ordering.

candidates.rationale: Place ephemeral plans below durable run state and define their non-authoritative Continue semantics.
Define the machine-readable ephemeral plan schema, transitions, and priority hierarchy.
Implement plan validation, DAG selection, lifecycle transitions, and auto-deletion.
Add adversarial DAG, priority, lifecycle, namespacing, and cleanup coverage.
Integrate the ephemeral planner into existing policy/tool/test indexes while keeping .session non-canonical and ignored.

applied_changes.description: Integrated non-authoritative session plans into authority, context, and conventions.
Added deterministic ephemeral session planner tool.
Added Git ignore and integrated session planner into workspace/config/tool/test indexes and impact policy.
